_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13), Flooded Strand's target is SEARCHED, not the first library match. Board: two Plains; hand: Flooded Strand + Drogskol Captain ({1}{W}{U}); library: Plains filler with exactly one Island (the deck's only blue source left). Play the Strand, crack it for the ISLAND, cast the Captain T3, attack T4 for 2 -> win T4. A first-in-library-order pick (Plains) would leave the Captain uncastable for the whole game (no other blue source, Plains draws only). Also pins the crack-on-play variant offered BESIDE the kept hold (FetchCrackOnPlayOffered): with only the hold, the Strand's activation ran in the trailing pass after the casts and this was a T5 win at every budget (measured at --budget-ms 0 --depth 5).
